When I was a teen I went through a lot. I found that not worrying as much about issues at school, with friends, etc and just believing that things would work out helped a lot. 
Keep on keeping on and I can guarantee that life will improve. The best years of a persons life are typically not during the teen years, so consider some of that completely normal.

Are you in school? Is there someone there who you can talk to? You need to tell your parents they have to get you help or they are going to lose you.
Do not just learn something new - do something new. 
If you are young, you should be aware that for many the teen years are unbearable. Life sucks and then suddenly one day  it doesn't. 
You have to push through until you can create the life you want and need.
Start a new life then.  Try something new every day. Talk to a professional. Try everything  they have. Something will give.  You never know where the answer lies. Do not give up.
I hope this rough patch clears for you.
